topic: How Multilayer Perceptrons (MLP) Store Facts in Transformers

sections.title: The Analogy: Library vs. Book Content
lecture_lines: Attention mechanisms act like a library's index catalog.
MLP layers store the actual knowledge contents.
Like books, MLPs hold the facts within.
animations: Create a library icon (label: 'Index') in light blue (#ADD8E6).
Create a book icon (label: 'Content') in white (#FFFFFF).
Move book icon into library icon to show categorization.

sections.title: The MLP Mechanism: Key-Value Memories
lecture_lines: Input vector activates a specific key.
Neurons act like locks for specific patterns.
animations: Display MLP layers as rectangles in light blue (#ADD8E6).
Animate individual weights as pulsating nodes using green (#00FF00).
Display signal flowing through nodes as white (#FFFFFF) arrows.

sections.title: Visualizing Weights as Knowledge
lecture_lines: Facts aren't single nodes, but constellations.
Activation lights up a specific neural path.
This forms the knowledge representation pattern.
Spotlight effect shows fact distribution clearly.
Connections define the stored relational truth.
animations: Visualize a weight vector in light cyan (#E0FFFF) pointing to an output.
Flash the vector in gold (#FFD700) to represent 'active' knowledge.
Label the vector 'Learned Knowledge' in white (#FFFFFF).
Spotlight a distribution of nodes with a warm glow.
Show connecting lines forming a pattern in light cyan (#E0FFFF).

sections.title: Conclusion and Limitations
lecture_lines: MLPs function as compressed, fuzzy databases.
